# SPD-078 — Multi-line handoff text does not survive the render-import round trip

## Brief
A handoff whose what text holds a blank line renders as several lines under Handoffs that import_handoffs cannot parse back into one row, so a disaster-recovery import keeps the whole section as verbatim prose and splits the handoff rows; proposal titles with newlines may share the problem in Proposals received and Ticket proposals.

Evidence: SPD-076 review case G1 (docs/spikes/spd-076/review.md): a handoffs row with what = 'x', blank line, then two more lines, rendered then imported into a fresh home, came back with an imported_sections Handoffs row holding the rendered text; the re-render was byte-identical. render_handoff_rows writes what verbatim with no continuation indent, unlike render_log_rows and render_proposal_rows.
